title: 2-room apartment in Sector 6: checked figures and real costs
description: How much a 2-room apartment costs in Sector 6 in 2026: real grids, 21% VAT, advances, and compared areas, with figures checked on September 17, 2026.
descriptionLlm: How much a 2-room apartment costs in Sector 6 in 2026: real grids, 21% VAT, advances, and compared areas, with figures checked on September 17, 2026.
keywords: apartament 2 camere bucuresti sector 6, pret apartament 2 camere sector 6, apartamente noi sector 6, Ilioara Residence, avans apartament nou, TVA apartament nou
lead: We counted on metru-patrat.ro on September 17, 2026: in Sector 6 there are 16 developers working with 131 individually tracked apartments, of which 116 are still waiting for their buyer. The list price of new buildings stands at 1,542 euros per square meter without VAT, meaning around 1,866 euros with 21% VAT added, and we placed these figures next to the Ilioara Residence grid. The price in the ad is the starting point: after it come VAT, the reservation, the advance, and, if you take out a loan, the bank rules. In the lines below you will go through each step, with the sector areas placed side by side, and at the end you get the verdict in short. If you want a broader background, apartment prices in Bucharest move month by month and are worth browsing before viewings.

sections.h2: Sector 6 is below the city average, and the figures show this

blocks.x: On September 17, 2026, hartapreturilor.ro measured 1,903 euros per square meter for apartments in Bucharest from active ads. New buildings in the sector sit one step lower: 1,542 euros per square meter without VAT, 1,866 euros with VAT included. Demand exists, but it is not distributed evenly: the average absorption in the sector is 8%, and the differences between areas, which you see below, are large. metru-patrat.ro declares itself an informative monitor, so the figures there are a starting benchmark, not the final word, and the availability of a specific apartment is something you check directly with the developer.

sections.h2: The Ilioara Residence grid starts from 107,500 euros

blocks.x: Two rooms at Ilioara Residence cost between 107,500 and 136,500 euros without VAT, with surfaces between 47 and 84 total square meters, usable plus terrace. As a benchmark, an ordinary new building two-room apartment has around 50 usable meters.

With the sector average in hand, the math works out quickly. A two-room apartment of 50 usable meters comes out to 77,100 euros without VAT, approximately 93,300 euros with 21% VAT; the 55-meter version reaches 84,810 euros without VAT, around 102,600 euros with VAT. The budget of the smallest Ilioara two-room apartment, at 107,500 euros without VAT, would buy you around 69.7 usable meters at the sector average. Simply put, you pay above the sector average, and the logic of the difference lies in the included features, which you see below.

sections.h2: 21% VAT, and the 9% window closes on September 30, 2026

blocks.x: Starting August 1, 2025, Law 141/2025 raised the standard VAT rate to 21%, and it applies to apartments in new buildings. The reduced 9% rate survived only for those who had signed the pre-contract by July 31, 2025, with the building finished by September 30, 2026, at a price below the threshold of 600,000 lei without VAT and with a maximum of 120 usable meters.

On September 17, 2026, when we read the figures, the September 30, 2026 threshold is 13 days away. If you are just now looking for an apartment, you calculate from the beginning with 21% VAT, without shortcuts.

sections.h2: How much advance the developer and the bank ask from you

blocks.x: The reservation at Ilioara costs you 2,000 euros plus VAT, then the developer asks for a 30% advance from the price without VAT, which for the smallest two-room apartment means 32,250 euros. The rest, until the building is handed over in December 2026, is established in the pre-contract, line by line.

If you go with a mortgage loan, NBR rules ask, on a case-by-case basis, for an advance between 15% and 25% for the standard loan, depending on the currency and how many homes you already own; we checked the rules on September 17, 2026. The regulatory minimum in lei for the first home stands at 15%, but banks frequently ask for more, and the figure that matters for your pocket comes out of the written offer issued in your name.

This is also where Noua Casa 2026 comes in: the program continues, with a guarantee fund of 500 million lei approved in May 2026, and cuts the advance to 5% for homes up to 70,000 euros and to 15% for new homes between 70,001 and 140,000 euros. The smallest Ilioara two-room apartment, with VAT added, exceeds 130,000 euros, so it belongs to the 15% bracket. The loan runs only in lei, for a maximum of 30 years, with an IRCC interest rate plus a capped margin. The program is used only once in a lifetime, the home must be finished and registered in the land registry, have an energy efficiency certificate of A, B, or C, and you declare that you do not own another home larger than 50 square meters.

sections.h2: Sector areas behave differently, and absorption tells you the truth

blocks.x: Militari-Iuliu Maniu gathers 91 units, of which 76 are available, at 1,488 euros per square meter without VAT and an absorption rate of 16%. On Timisoara-Pacii Blvd. there are 12 units, 10 available, at 1,279 euros per square meter, with the liveliest movement in the sector: an absorption rate of 17%. Drumul Taberei-Ghencea sits at the opposite end: 18 available apartments, a price of 2,022 euros per square meter, and an absorption rate of 0%, so nothing left from the tracked stock. In Crangasi-Giulesti-Orsova 74 units are waiting, all available, without a published price average, and Lujerului-Politehnica-Regie has only 6 available apartments.

Published entries start from Rotar Park Residence, with 72,727 euros and 1,777 euros per square meter, followed by Panorama City at 75,000 euros (1,807 euros per square meter), Neofort 49 Militari at 77,800 euros, and Yola 71 at 79,900 euros. Up at the other end, Noble Piatra Craiului asks from 150,900 euros. A price from 72,727 euros is not an invoice, it is a discussion threshold. And between the published extremes, from 1,154 euros per square meter at Maniu 141 up to 2,022 euros at Stellaris Residencias, the areas with a published price differ by almost twice, a 1.75 ratio; if you calculate only the areas with an announced average, the range goes from 1,279 euros at Pacii to 2,022 euros in Drumul Taberei, a 1.58 ratio.

sections.h2: What is included in the price at Ilioara and what you pay extra

blocks.x: Ilioara Residence includes underfloor heating throughout the entire apartment, Salamander 7-chamber tripan joinery, and its own Ariston 24 kW boiler in the price. The building has a ground floor plus 8 floors and 35 apartments, with a short landing, 4 apartments per floor, and the buyer commission stands at 0%. You pay for parking separately: 20,000 euros for a single space, 25,000 euros for a Klauss double-type space, both without VAT, so you calculate this in your budget before getting attached to an apartment without a car space. The building is handed over in December 2026, so you have another autumn to prepare the money and documents.
If you browse the broader offer of new apartments in the city, the Ilioara grid remains your benchmark for what truly included features mean.

faq.q: How much does a 2-room apartment cost in Sector 6?
faq.a: New buildings in the sector are published at 1,542 euros per square meter without VAT, meaning approximately 1,866 euros with 21% VAT, according to the metru-patrat.ro monitor on September 17, 2026. An ordinary two-room apartment of 50 usable meters comes out to around 93,300 euros with VAT at the sector average. Published entries start from 72,727 euros at Rotar Park Residence, and the Ilioara Residence grid starts at 107,500 euros without VAT.

faq.q: What advance do I need for a new apartment?
faq.a: On the developer side, Ilioara asks for a 2,000 euro reservation plus VAT and a 30% advance from the price without VAT, meaning 32,250 euros for the smallest two-room apartment. At the bank, the NBR rule asks for between 15% and 25% advance for the standard loan, depending on the currency and how many homes you own; 15% is the regulatory minimum in lei for the first home, but banks frequently ask for more. With Noua Casa 2026, the advance drops to 5% for homes up to 70,000 euros and to 15% for new homes between 70,001 and 140,000 euros, with a loan only in lei, for a maximum of 30 years, a program used only once in a lifetime. You extract the final figure from the written offer issued in your name.

faq.q: Is it worth waiting until the building is finished to see the apartment?
faq.a: At Ilioara, the building is handed over in December 2026. If you want to touch the finishes before you sign, you wait a few months; if the grid suits you, you reserve now and follow the construction site.
